title: Rewire gateway handle_post_slots to COSE_Sign1 decode; migrate resources.rs slot-claim tests
description: Child of l1qw.16.2 (GCP-6.5 Rust gateway slot-claim COSE_Sign1). Analysis done (worker-1, 2026-09-03): slot.rs RawSlotClaim::from_cose (slot.rs:516-612) already implements the full spec decode (protected {1:-65537} byte-exact with alg-decoy rejection, kid bstr(8) must equal payload gateway_iid, payload integer keys 1-6 required +7 optional, mode 0/1, slot bounds, 48-byte sig, sig_form=CoseSign1). resources.rs SlotClaim::encode_cose (resources.rs:820, from landed child .16.2.3) produces that envelope. THE GAP: the live handler handle_post_slots (resources.rs:2100) calls legacy SlotClaim::decode (raw map, gateway_count on wire, no COSE) then into_raw (resources.rs:1113) which REBUILDS RawSlotClaim via ::new with sig_form=DomainTranscript — that drops the COSE form and would verify against the legacy transcript digest, breaking spec peers. Plan: (1) in handle_post_slots replace decode+timestamp-gate+into_raw with slot::RawSlotClaim::from_cose(payload, self.slots_per_superframe) then validate_claim_timing(i64::try_from(raw.expiry()) -> on overflow return forbidden, unix_now()) — expiry is REQUIRED in COSE form (from_cose enforces); keep silent-discard empty 2.04 on decode error; the post-verify handler body already operates on RawSlotClaim methods (slots()/gateway_iid()/superframe_id()) so no further changes there. (2) DELETE legacy SlotClaim::encode (resources.rs:872), encode_canonical (:928), decode (:974), into_raw (:1113) and the orphaned KEY_CLAIM_* constants — gateway_count must leave the wire. slot.rs slot_claim_transcript / RawSlotClaim::new (DomainTranscript form) stay: pub items, other beads (l1qw.16.4 C-side) may still reference; do not touch slot.rs. (3) Migrate resources.rs mod tests to COSE: helper signed_slot_claim(seed, slots, superframe, seq) -> (Vec<u8> envelope, [u8;32] pubkey) building SlotClaim::new(iid,...) with timestamp=Some(unix_now()+100) then encode_cose(&private,&public); add signed_slot_claim_with_expiry variant for the timing test (far/ok expiry must be INSIDE the signed payload — cannot tamper post-sign like legacy). Garbage-sig test (2825): sign valid envelope then corrupt the trailing 48 sig bytes. Missing-sig test (2839): truncate the envelope (malformed => same silent-discard assertion). slot_claim_encode_decode (2697) and slot_claim_canonical_encoding (2718) are redundant with encode_cose_roundtrips_through_from_cose_and_verifies (2438) and slot.rs oracle tests — delete them. All other handle_post_slots tests (2786,2793,2813,2833,2841,2865,2902,2944,2990,3016) swap claim.encode() for the envelope helper. Verify with cargo test -p lichen-gateway. Lands with or after the vector-mirror child; lichend/end_to_end migration child depends on this one.
close_reason: Duplicate of project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.16.2.2 — created twice in one retry loop (the first bd create succeeded but its JSON output parse failed, so the command was re-run and created .16.2.2). This twin is never worked; all plan content is identical. Working copy: .16.2.2.
